Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

1. Scope — Prescribes preferred capacities for mechanical and Jiydrauiic presses. 

2. Terminology 

2.1 Capacity — The force that the slide of a press can exert while working through a specified 
distance above the bottom of stroke.

EXPLAtJATORY NOTE 

This standard has been prepared with a view to assist the manufacturers of mechanical and 
hydraulic presses in designing new presses. Variety reduction is one of the objects aimed at for an 
organized development of any industry and it is hoped that this standard will be of help reducing the 
prevalent capacities of presses for selection within a rationalized series of capacities. 

IS : 7468-1974 ' Recommendations on preferred strokes for mechanical and hydraulic presses ' 
is the other standard in the series of Indian Standards on parameters for presses. 



Adopted 19 November, 1974
